messages:
Sam: Handoff — quick async: two active incidents right now. High level below, TL;DR at the top.

Sam: TL;DR: INC-3785 causing tokenization latency on hosted-api (affects smaller p95 bursts). INC-3792 causing OOMs on dedicated-pool-3. Mitigations applied, need watch and follow-ups.

Sam: INC-3785 details: sudden tokenization CPU spike after model v2 rollout to canary. Symptoms: p95 tokenization CPU up from 60% -> 98%, request queuing, ~30s tail latency spikes for ~1% of requests.
Sam: Mitigation: rolled canary back to model v1 on shard-a, disabled new tokenizer feature flag, temporarily increased tokenization worker count on region-us-west by 2. Added short-term rate limit for bursty endpoints.
Sam: Logs snippet: ```2026-07-10T14:10:12Z ERROR tokenizer: panic on token boundary - input length 5120 -> evicting KV cache```

Priya: Acked. I'm taking lead on INC-3785 during my shift. I'll watch the tokenization CPU, confirm rollback stability, and measure p50/p95 over next 2 hours. If we see repro, I'll re-run the tokenizer regression harness.

Mike: For INC-3792 (dedicated-pool-3 OOM): we had 3 OOMs across grpc-worker-7/9. Root cause suspected spike in batch size due to malformed client headers. Mitigation: re-applied node taint to prevent scheduling heavy batches on pool-3, bumped oom_kill_disable on the workers, and enabled temporary per-conn batch cap (max 64 -> 32).

Mike: I opened a quick PR with guardrails for the batching logic: https://git.internal/redwood/repo/pull/4821. Short description in PR: enforce per-request token cap and defensive parsing for client-specified batch params.

Julia: Updated the runbook: added steps for tokenizer rollback, where to click in Console, and the short checklist for dedicated pool taints. Also added a postmortem stub for INC-3792 so we can capture follow-ups. Link: https://wiki.internal/redwood/oncall/runbooks/tokenizer-incidents

infra-bot: Incident alert payload: INC-3785 triggered at 2026-07-10T14:08:09Z, severity: high, impacted: hosted-api (region: us-west), metric: tokenizer_cpu_percent > 90% for 5m.

Sam: Next steps: Priya to monitor and escalate if rollback doesn't reduce p95 within 30m. Mike to merge batching PR and roll to canary staging. Julia to collect logs and start the postmortem timeline. I'll stay available for 1hr then handover to Priya.

Priya: Acknowledged. I'll post a follow-up status update in this thread at +30m with metrics and any new mitigations.

Mike: Merged the PR to staging and kicked a canary; will notify if we see regressions.

Sam: Thanks all — handing off oncall. Please react with :thumbsup: when you see this.

Priya: :thumbsup: I'll take it from here and escalate to SRE if tokenization CPU doesn't fall after 30m.

Julia: :thumbsup: I'll coordinate the postmortem notes and attach relevant log queries.
